module: Generator for the side walls (left and right) of a Track Builder track segment. It defines a box-shaped wall profile (24 faces) and, depending on the segment's wall height and quality, extrudes this profile along the segment's points, with optional start and end caps.
notes: Each wall is generated only if segment.meshInfo.leftWall.active (or rightWall.active) is true; otherwise the list contains nil in its place.
Heights come from segment.leftWallHeight / rightWallHeight (via the 'leftWallHeight' and 'rightWallHeight' fields passed to compileMeshInfo).
If segment.quality == 4, getMeshes returns an empty table.
Material: segment.materialInfo.leftWall / rightWall, otherwise 'track_editor_A_border'. Tag: 'side -1' or 'side 1'.
Side effect: increments segment.submeshCount and fills segment.submeshIndexes.

getMeshes.desc: Returns the meshes of the segment's active left and right walls.

segment.desc: Track Builder segment (points, quality, meshInfo.leftWall/rightWall, materialInfo, submeshCount, submeshIndexes).

returns.desc: List of mesh tables {verts, uvs, normals, faces, material, tag} (may contain nil).
